title.zh: 抗幻觉训练买到的，可能主要是少说和廉价剪枝：CHAIR 分数下降里，去掉「说得更少」之后，大半能被一个冻结的 11 维事后探针复现

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.25814（Lingkai Bu、Qian Gao）：视觉语言模型里，偏好训练是减少物体幻觉的标准做法，新方法都会报出更低的 CHAIR 分数。作者追问这下降由什么构成。每个训练后的系统都先与「基座模型说明截到同一物体召回率」比较，以去掉来自「说得更少」的增益；其余再与一个故意做弱、冻结的、只用 500 张标注图拟合的 11 维事后探针能复现的部分比较。分析标准事先写进代码，在被评判的输出出现前就冻结。LLaVA-1.5-7B 上的 8 种公开方法中，探针能复现「去掉少说之后」剩余增益的至少三分之二：COCO 上 7/8、AMBER 上 8/8、Object HalBench 上 6/8，唯一稳定例外是 RLAIF-V；后来同时放出 LLaVA-1.5 与 Qwen2.5-VL 的 SENTINEL 也达到同一标准。作者自己的 DPO 检查点上，这套记账在 Qwen2.5-VL 上成立，在 InternVL2.5 的 COCO 上则有 4 种训练设计中的 2 种不成立。召回率对齐时，基座模型加该探针往往优于截断；用探针或物体级 CLIP 分数给模型自己的样本打标再做 DPO，在 Qwen2.5-VL 上分别收回真值标注 DPO 超简洁增益的 0.70 与 0.87。人工判断显示，探针删掉的句子比截断会删的更常是错的；对 CHAIR 评估器精度的人工核查低于预先设定的标准，作者把它记为局限。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t809。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.25814 (Lingkai Bu, Qian Gao) asks what the CHAIR-score drop from preference training against object hallucination in vision-language models actually consists of. Each trained system is compared with its base model’s caption truncated to the same object recall, which removes the part of the gain that comes from saying less; the remainder is compared with what a deliberately weak, frozen, eleven-feature post-hoc probe fitted on 500 annotated images can reproduce. All criteria were specified in the analysis code and frozen before the outputs they judge existed. For eight public methods on LLaVA-1.5-7B, the probe reproduces at least two thirds of what training removes beyond saying less for 7 of 8 methods on COCO, 8 of 8 on AMBER and 6 of 8 on Object HalBench, with RLAIF-V the consistent exception; a later public method released for both LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL (SENTINEL) meets the same bar on both. On the authors’ own DPO checkpoints the accounting holds on Qwen2.5-VL but fails on InternVL2.5 on COCO for 2 of 4 training designs. At matched recall, the base model plus the probe often beats truncation. DPO on the model’s own samples labelled by the probe or by an object-level CLIP score recovers 0.70 and 0.87 of the beyond-brevity gain of ground-truth-labelled DPO on Qwen2.5-VL. Human judgements show that the sentences the probe deletes are wrong more often than those truncation would delete; a human check of the CHAIR evaluator’s precision falls below a pre-set bar, which the authors report as a limitation. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t809. Chaos only.

title.zh: 已经表征了，却可能被读错：后训练并不一定改写模型内部已经表征了什么，而会改它如何把已有表征读成答案

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.26584（Jochen Laubrock）：后训练改的是模型已经表征了什么，还是它如何把已有表征读成答案？作者在六组开源基座模型及其后训练版本上，把线性探针与模型自己的回答（用信号检测论分析）对照。判断德语文本是人写还是 AI 写时，探针和词 n-gram 分类器都能分清，模型自己的回答却分不清，还常常把顺序排反。后训练把回答的敏感度平均再降 Δd′ = −0.34（三个提示上为 −0.29）。它对「给定的基率」的用法也变了：基座模型对先验赔率变化的对数赔率移动偏小，多数后训练模型则偏大。有阶段性检查点的两个模型里，这一变化发生在监督微调期间；模型拼接指向浅层，从中层起是文本之后的位置、而不是文本位置本身，把变化在检查点之间传递。语料不能公开，作者另加一个可用公开数据复现的案例：否定句的真值。这里方向相反——探针几乎总能读出真值，若干基座模型的回答用不上它，后训练反而修好了读出；到中层，修复落在陈述之后的位置。训练研究里，在其他微调数据不变的情况下加入 2,000 条正确标注的新闻文本作者判断，会改进报纸和教材上的回答，却把聊天语料上的回答翻转，并跟随基座模型上一个用新闻训练的探针。因此后训练改变的是如何从已有表征里读出判断，一小段训练信号就能设定方向。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t919、t953。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26584 (Jochen Laubrock) asks whether post-training changes what a language model represents, or how that representation is read out into an answer. In six open-weight base models and their post-trained versions, linear probes are compared with the models’ own answers, analyzed with signal detection theory. For judging whether German texts were written by a human or an AI, probes and word n-gram classifiers separated the classes well, but the answers did not and often ordered the texts inversely. Post-training lowered the sensitivity of the answers on average (Δd′ = −0.34 across model families; −0.29 across three prompts). It also changed the use of a stated base rate: base models shifted their log-odds by less than the stated change in prior odds, most post-trained models by more. In two models with stage-wise checkpoints, the change occurred during supervised fine-tuning; model stitching implicated the early layers, and from mid-depth on, internal states at positions after the text, not those of the text, transferred the change between checkpoints. The corpora cannot be shared, so the paper adds a case reproducible from public data: the truth of negated statements. Here post-training acted in the opposite direction: probes decoded truth at or near ceiling in every model, the answers of several base models did not use it, and post-training repaired them; by mid-depth the repair resided at the positions after the statement. In a training study, adding 2,000 correctly labeled authorship judgments of news texts to otherwise identical fine-tuning data improved answers on newspaper and textbook corpora and inverted them on chats, where they followed a news-trained probe of the base model. Post-training thus changed how a judgment is read out of what a model represents, and a small training signal can set its direction. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t919 and t953. Chaos only.

title.zh: 听得到却说不出：音频大模型里少数注意力头能跟踪被问声音出现的时间，但答案并不表达它们跟踪到的东西

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.25960（Jongbhin Woo、Jaewook Jeong、Joon Son Chung）：音频大模型可能听得出被问声音出现在何时，却说不出来。作者找到少数跟踪该声音的注意力头：查询一变它们就移，声音一挪它们就跟，去掉或堵住它们常常损害模型的时间戳；但答案并不表达它们跟踪到的东西，直接从头里读出的区间反而优于模型原答案，还能找回时间戳漏掉的事件。他们提出无需训练的 head-guided decoding：保留模型对「声音是否存在」的判断，再用这些头给出的先验重排候选时间戳。在开发集上选出的头，原样转到新录音和自由文本查询上仍然有效；它对三个音频大模型的时间戳都有改进，在每项基准上都高于只读这些头，并且在多数设定下优于随机选头的引导。在模型训练之后发布的录音上，它把 mIoU 从 0.07–0.36 提到 0.48–0.56。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t952。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.25960 (Jongbhin Woo, Jaewook Jeong, Joon Son Chung) finds that audio LLMs can know when a queried sound occurs but fail to say it. A few attention heads track the queried sound: they shift when the query changes, follow the sound when it moves, and removing or blocking them often hurts the model’s timestamps. Yet the answer does not express what they track. Intervals read directly from these heads outperform the model’s original answer and recover events that its timestamps miss. The authors introduce head-guided decoding, which needs no training: it keeps the model’s decision on whether the sound is present and rescores candidate timestamps with a prior from these heads. Heads selected on development data transfer unchanged to new recordings and free-text queries; the method improves the timestamps of three audio LLMs, scores above their head readout on every benchmark, and in most settings outperforms random-head guidance. On recordings released after the models were trained, it raises mIoU from 0.07–0.36 to 0.48–0.56. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t952. Chaos only.

title.zh: 注意力头特化不只随训练时间分阶段出现，还是样本量上的相变：头特化对应测试误差等观测量的非解析点

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.26228（Léo Catteau、O. Duranthon、Lenka Zdeborová）：注意力头在训练中会分化出不同功能，往往随分阶段出现，并伴随模型行为的急剧变化。这一现象多按训练时间来研究，作者改问它如何依赖可用训练数据的量。经验上，BERT 里专司句法关系的头会随着数据量增大而出现。他们再在一个可解的高维多头注意力模型中证明：在该模型里，头特化是样本复杂度上的真正相变，对应测试误差等观测量的非解析点。依数据结构和正则化，特化可以先经过无信息的头分化，或经由一连串相变逐步恢复更弱的潜在特征，构成一种统计上的简约偏好。最后，他们把这些统计相变与在线学习中特化头的分阶段出现联系起来，从而把特化的统计来源与动力学来源拆开。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.26228 (Léo Catteau, O. Duranthon, Lenka Zdeborová) notes that attention heads specialize into distinct functions during training, often emerging in stages together with sharp changes in model behavior. The phenomenon has mostly been studied as a function of training time; the authors ask how it depends on the amount of available training data. Empirically, heads specialized to syntactic relations in BERT emerge as the dataset size increases. In a solvable high-dimensional model of multi-head attention they establish that, in this model, head specialization is a genuine phase transition in sample complexity, corresponding to a non-analyticity in the test error and other observables. Depending on data structure and regularization, specialization can follow uninformative head differentiation or occur through a cascade of phase transitions that progressively recover weaker latent features, providing a statistical form of simplicity bias. Finally they relate these statistical transitions to the stagewise emergence of specialized heads during online learning, disentangling statistical from dynamical origins of head specialization. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: Meta：广告排序模型机群上的技术传播已由 agent 承担六成以上，并称工程效率约 3 倍、年底算力节省超 4,500 万美元

summary.zh: Engineering at Meta（2026-11-18，经 TLDR AI 11-19 进入本窗口）《AI agents to scale ML innovations across ads ranking models》：Ranking Engineer Agent（REA）的后续。把已验证的架构/训练技术（如 Wukong、Interformer）适配到许多不同的广告排序模型，这一「技术传播」现已由 agent 承担。官方称自 2026 年 3 月起 agent 处理超过 60% 的传播，早期结果是工程效率约 3 倍、部分组合训练计算中位数少约 4 倍，并估计年底前节省超过 4,500 万美元算力；关键决策与上线仍由人审批。目标是把技术传到机群的时间从一年以上缩短到 3 个月，并用会从结果中改策略的自进化 agent。本轮读了正文开头与结论，方法部分未通读。数字均为官方自报，未核。对照 t934、t947。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: Engineering at Meta (Nov 18, 2026; reached this window via TLDR AI on Nov 19), “AI agents to scale ML innovations across ads ranking models,” is a follow-up to the Ranking Engineer Agent (REA). “Technique propagation”—adapting proven architecture and training methods such as Wukong and Interformer to many distinct ads-ranking models—is now agent-driven. The company says that since March 2026 agents have handled more than 60% of propagation; early results include about 3× engineering productivity, a median 4× cut in training compute on some combinations, and an estimated $45M+ in compute savings by year-end. title.zh: OpenAI Performance Factory：用 Codex agent 工作流调查、修复并验证 ChatGPT 性能回退，约三个月内完成 1,700 多次调查

title.zh: Jeveration：System One 的并行快决策也可以在单次前向中生成图像，用共享随机状态协调各位置以保持全局一致

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.24738（Yuhe Liu、Qi Li、Shihua Zhang、Xinchao Wang）：Jeveration 表明，Jev 这类 System One 模型的并行快决策范式，也可以在单次前向中生成图像。它建立在冻结的视觉-语言模型上，把视觉-语义知识改用于整体图像生成。关键困难是全局一致：同一提示允许许多有效图像，但各位置的并行预测必须收敛成一张完整图。作者因此用共享随机状态协调各位置的并行预测，使每次采样得到不同但自洽的图像；由于在直接图像监督下模型倾向忽略该状态，他们先学习离散图像码的分布来引导单次生成。同一检查点还统一了图生图与稠密预测，三种任务都是一次前向。实验称 512×512 图像生成约 78 毫秒，比现有统一模型最快可达 122 倍，质量与稠密预测仍有竞争力。代码自称公开于 github.com/Carol-lyh/Jeveration。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t896。本周 Jev 配额不因本条占用。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.24738 (Yuhe Liu, Qi Li, Shihua Zhang, Xinchao Wang) introduces Jeveration, showing that the fast, parallel decision paradigm of System One models such as Jev can also generate images in a single forward pass. It builds on a frozen vision-language model and repurposes visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is global consistency: a single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. All positions are therefore conditioned on a shared random state, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Because the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, the authors first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. The same checkpoint also unifies image-to-image generation and dense prediction, so all three tasks run in one forward pass. They report 78 ms for a 512×512 image, up to 122× faster than existing unified models, with competitive image quality and dense-prediction performance. Code is claimed at github.com/Carol-lyh/Jeveration. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t896. This item does not occupy the weekly Jev formal-post quota. Chaos only.

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.23546 (Guy Zyskind) finds that researchers increasingly use LLMs to validate research questions, and that the models make open questions sound partly studied and overstate what related papers establish. The models recognize most of those overstatements when asked to check the papers’ full texts separately. On 40 questions drawn from newly accepted papers, GPT-6-Astra correctly judges 98% to be unstudied, but states that status plainly in only 8% of ordinary answers. All six frontier systems show reporting gaps of 30–90 percentage points. Across 22 models given identical papers, higher capability is associated with more accurate judgments and larger reporting gaps. The failure is asymmetric: when the answering papers are supplied, models correctly identify studied questions in 88–100% of ordinary answers. Building a fixed answer from each model’s judgment and separate checks of cited papers raises Astra’s clear reporting of open status from 8% to 95%, with improvements in all six systems. title.zh: 总体进步可以替代被扣住的训练数据：数据过滤只能推迟能力，学会该技能所需的补训数据会随模型进步而减少

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.24844 (Mark Marosi, Peter Antal) asks how long withholding training data delays a capability, and how much data is needed to acquire it later. The authors show that the general progress a model makes on the rest of its training data substitutes for the withheld samples. The pattern holds for chess, Othello, molecular strings, bracket languages and web text, and the delay of a withheld skill in larger models was predicted from smaller ones. A chess model never explicitly trained to respond to check ranked the legal responses almost as well as a model that was. When the withheld data was then restored, the models acquired the skill with a small fraction of the data needed from initialization, and that fraction decreased as the models progressed; a control rule of equal difficulty was learned much more slowly. A programming language withheld from the training text of a 7-billion-parameter model was regained in the same way. Data filtering therefore delays a capability rather than blocking it permanently. Code is claimed at github.com/Mapika/progress-substitutes-data. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 可塑性与稳定性并不互为镜像：学新程序时更新 QK 能保住一半以上已存的陈述记忆，更新 VO 则会丢掉大约五分之四

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.23427（Jinjun Peng、Wailiang Zhao、Baishakhi Ray、Zhou Yu、Jufeng Yang）：持续学习里的可塑性与稳定性通常按整模型和与任务无关的方式来研究，不同设定下结论并不一致。作者受陈述性记忆与程序性记忆的区分启发，在可干净测量的受控合成环境里，按 Transformer 模块和任务类型分开看。结果是双重分离：程序学习时查询-键（QK）与值-输出（VO）投影可塑性最强，陈述性记忆则是 MLP 最可塑。但稳定性并不只是可塑性的镜像——学新程序时，只更新 QK 能保留一半以上已存储的陈述记忆，更新 MLP 保留得少得多，更新 VO 则会丢掉大约五分之四。定向的模块重置与恢复实验解释了这种不对称：可塑性取决于哪个模块最适合该任务的主计算或存储，稳定性则取决于已有能力对这个模块的全部依赖方式，包括访问存在其他模块里的信息。在更现实的模型与任务上，这种不对称大体同样出现。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.23427 (Jinjun Peng, Wailiang Zhao, Baishakhi Ray, Zhou Yu, Jufeng Yang) notes that plasticity and stability in continual learning are usually studied at the whole-model level and in a task-agnostic way, with divergent conclusions across settings. Inspired by the distinction between declarative and procedural memory, they measure both across transformer modules and task types in a controlled synthetic environment. They find a double dissociation: query-key (QK) and value-output (VO) projections are the most plastic on procedural tasks, whereas MLPs are the most plastic on declarative memorization. Stability does not simply mirror plasticity: when learning a new procedure, updating QK retains over half of the stored declarative memory, while updating MLPs retains far less and updating VO loses roughly four-fifths. Targeted module reset-and-recovery experiments explain the asymmetry: plasticity tracks which module is best suited to a task’s primary computation or storage, whereas stability depends on all the ways the existing capability relies on that module, including access to information stored in other modules. Experiments on a more realistic model and tasks broadly echo these dynamics. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

summary.zh: 项目页 energy-based-reasoners.github.io（HN 300/52）与 arXiv 2611.08977（William Chen、Alexi Gladstone、Zeyu Li、Heng Ji、Yilun Du；Duke / UIUC / Harvard）：Energy-Based Reasoners（EBR）在潜在推理状态上学习能量函数，把循环更新写成对该能量的梯度下降——能量用来给候选打分（不需要外部验证器），梯度用来 refinement，并在梯度范数低于阈值时停止。作者还引入基于探索的训练，以发现更多模态、在更宽的状态集上塑造能量面。四个算法推理基准上，1.8M 参数的 EBR 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上单样本 99.4%、5 次采样 99.9%，并称比次优模型（文中为 EqR）少用 345 倍推理 FLOPs，训练计算相当；自适应停止比固定深度 EBR 少约 10.9 倍 FLOPs 仍保持 99.9%。N-Queens 与 Graph Coloring 上称覆盖率领先，单样本准确率接近 100%。HN 条目标题写「385x」，与项目页/论文的 345× 不符，以项目页为准。数字均作者自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

The energy scores candidates without an external verifier; its gradient guides refinement and, once its norm falls below a threshold, stopping. Exploration-based training is used to find more modes and shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. On four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, a 1.8M-parameter EBR is reported to reach 99.4% single-sample and 99.9% with 5 samples on Sudoku-Extreme, using 345× less inference FLOPs than the next-best model (EqR in the write-up) at comparable training compute; adaptive stopping is said to keep 99.9% with about 10.9× fewer FLOPs than a fixed-depth EBR. On N-Queens and Graph Coloring the authors claim state-of-the-art coverage of distinct valid solutions with near-100% single-sample accuracy. The HN item is titled “385x”; that figure does not match the 345× on the project page and paper, which are treated as authoritative here. Figures are the authors’ own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

brief.en: Project page energy-based-reasoners.github.io (HN 300/52) and arXiv 2611.08977 (William Chen, Alexi Gladstone, Zeyu Li, Heng Ji, Yilun Du; Duke / UIUC / Harvard): Energy-Based Reasoners (EBRs) learn an energy function over latent reasoning states and treat looped updates as gradient descent on that energy. The energy scores candidates without an external verifier; its gradient guides refinement and, once its norm falls below a threshold, stopping. Exploration-based training is used to find more modes and shape the energy landscape over a broader set of states. On four algorithmic reasoning benchmarks, a 1.8M-parameter EBR is reported to reach 99.4% single-sample and 99.9% with 5 samples on Sudoku-Extreme, using 345× less inference FLOPs than the next-best model (EqR in the write-up) at comparable training compute; adaptive stopping is said to keep 99.9% with about 10.9× fewer FLOPs than a fixed-depth EBR. On N-Queens and Graph Coloring the authors claim state-of-the-art coverage of distinct valid solutions with near-100% single-sample accuracy. The HN item is titled “385x”; that figure does not match the 345× on the project page and paper, which are treated as authoritative here. Figures are the authors’ own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 偏见头测到的也许根本不是偏见：头级偏见归因里，选头统计量无法被识别为在测偏见，消融所谓偏见头也降不了不公平率

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.23218（S.M Seefat Alam）：把社会偏见定位到个别注意力头、再靠消融来「去偏见」的方法，其实是用公平指标的事后效果来验证，从未证明那个选头统计量在测偏见。作者在 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上审计：头图虽与标签盲的回复长度图高度相关（ρ=-0.950 与 -0.768），好像找到了表层混杂；但固定提示后，长度只解释该统计量 1% 的方差，真正解释 64% 的是提示身份，且排序并不随长度单调。同一提示内，公平标签、回复长度与受保护群体词几乎共线（φ=0.95），部分是标注规则本身使然，观察分析无法归因，这一家族的方法也没有做能做此区分的实验。实质主张同样不成立：两种读法下偏见选择性都不集中在后层；测试过的头集合消融后都不能降低不公平率；而其补集（按相反标签计分）却能稳定破坏拒答（p=2.7×10⁻⁵），说明这套管线在该尺度上确实能测到效应，只是测到的不是「偏见头」。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.23218 (S.M Seefat Alam) audits methods that localise social bias to individual attention heads and “debias” by ablating them. Those methods are validated by their effect on a fairness metric, never by evidence that the statistic used to choose the heads measures bias. On Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, the head map correlates at ρ = -0.950 and -0.768 with a label-blind response-length map, which looks like a surface confound; an intervention that holds the prompt fixed rejects that reading, because length then explains only 1% of the statistic’s variance. Prompt identity explains 64%, in an ordering that is not monotonic in length. Within any fixed prompt the fairness label, response length and the presence of a protected-group token are collinear at φ = 0.95, partly by definition of the labelling rule, so no observational analysis can attribute the map, and no method in this family runs an experiment that could. The substantive claims fail independently: bias selectivity is not late-layer-concentrated under either reference reading, and no head set tested reduces the unfairness rate when ablated. Its complement, scored on the opposite label, reliably destroys refusal (p = 2.7×10⁻⁵), so the pipeline detects effects at this scale, but not a bias head. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 能排出先后，并不等于知道落在哪一格：语言模型可以把政党立场排好序，却无法把单个政党放到同一尺度上

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.21878（Yousef Attia、Jarosław A. Chudziak）：现有基准几乎都在问「单个实体打几分」，并把它当成模型掌握了该领域；但文本里比较远多于测量，模型可能只有可靠排序、没有锚定的刻度。作者以日韩政党立场为试验台（比较宣言计划的编码数据作外部答案键）：给四个政党排序时，模型超过最强固定答案基线一倍以上；把单个政党放到同一尺度上，则低于该基线。失败的绝对定位里排序仍然保留，补上编码数值后定位接近天花板。因此，对同一事实的比较问题与绝对问题在这里测的不是同一件事，用其中一种建成的基准不能代表另一种。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21878 (Yousef Attia, Jarosław A. Chudziak) argues that nearly every benchmark of gradable social positions asks about one entity at a time and then reads that score as the model’s knowledge of the domain. Text about social entities carries far more comparison than measurement, so a model may hold a dependable ordering with no anchored scale. On party positions in Japan and South Korea, with the Comparative Manifesto Project’s coded data as an external answer key, models beat the strongest fixed-answer baseline by more than a factor of two when asked to order four parties, and fall below that baseline when asked to place one party on the same scale. The ordering survives inside those failed placements, and supplying the coded values lifts placement to near ceiling. Comparative and absolute questions about the same fact therefore measure different things here, and a benchmark built from one cannot speak for the other. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

title.zh: 所谓「道德回路」可能只是通用评价回路，定位到的特征则主要响应提示里的单词 morally

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.21705（Davide Liga、Liuwen Yu、Matteo Magnini）：可解释性方法能找到改变道德提示续写的注意力头和 SAE 特征，但该成分可能在响应道德内容、任何规范对行为的判断，或提示里的单词 morally。作者用 227 对经五人标注的最小对立（道德标准、谨慎/礼仪/审美/证据等其他规范，或描述性差异），在 14 个开源模型（Llama、Gemma、Qwen，1B–14B，基座与指令微调）上，分别带或不带 morally 一词进行检验。在每个模型里，改变道德答案的头属于模型做各类规范判断都要用的评价回路：有该提示词时，这些头在道德对立与其他规范对立上的效应份额比约为 1.00（97.5% 置信区间 [0.92, 1.07]；不带该词时为 0.90，[0.84, 0.96]），模型对两类判断同样依赖它们；提示并不要求判断时也需要这些头。在 ETHICS 基准的 400 个情景上，去掉它们会拿走可接受与不可接受情景之差的 37–39%，随机十个头只有 1–3%。定位到的 SAE 特征则主要响应单词 morally，而不是短语在说什么。隐藏状态里可以读出对立对的规范类别；在测试过的八个模型上，去掉承载该方向的向量会把道德裁决减弱几个百分点，其中七个模型里对道德裁决的削弱大于其他裁决。配对、评分、代码、训练好的 SAE 词典与结果文件自称将公开。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t708。不复测已失败词 sparse autoencoders。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21705 (Davide Liga, Liuwen Yu, Matteo Magnini) asks whether the attention heads and SAE features that change a model’s answer to a moral prompt respond to moral content, to the judgment of conduct by any norm, or to the word “morally” in the prompt. They built 227 minimal pairs, validated by five annotators, that differ in a moral standard, in another kind of norm (prudence, etiquette, aesthetics or evidence), or in a descriptive quality, and tested 14 open-weight models (Llama, Gemma and Qwen, 1B to 14B, base and instruction-tuned) with and without the word “morally”. In every model, the heads that change the moral answer belong to an evaluation circuit used for every kind of normative judgment tested: with the cue word, these heads carry the same share of the effect for moral as for other normative pairs (pooled ratio 1.00, 97.5% CI [0.92, 1.07]; 0.90, [0.84, 0.96] without it), and the models need them as much for both, including when the prompt does not ask for a judgment. On 400 ETHICS scenarios, removing them takes away 37 to 39% of the gap between acceptable and unacceptable scenarios, against 1 to 3% for ten random heads. The SAE features located respond mostly to the word “morally” rather than to what the phrase is about. The category of a pair can be read from hidden states; in the eight models tested, removing the direction that carries it weakens the moral verdict by a few percent, and more than the other verdicts in seven of them. The pairs, ratings, code, trained SAE dictionaries and result files are to be released. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t708. Do not retest the already-failed term sparse autoencoders. Chaos only.

title.zh: Conserved Verdicts：推理模型已经答对之后继续想，仍可能把正确答案想丢——该不该停，要看承诺与裁决之差，而不是最终正确性探针

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.21946（Jianghong Zhou、Hao Rong、Chen Lin）：推理模型已经答对之后继续想，仍可能把正确答案想丢。作者把链上同一时刻的两个概率分开：现在停下答案正确的概率叫承诺（commitment），最终答案正确的概率叫裁决（verdict）；仅用裁决——也就是最终正确性探针所估计的量——无法决定该不该停，因为它作为对既定结果的预报没有可预期的漂移；承诺–裁决差才等于继续思考还预期改变多少质量，也等于现在停下能拿到的准确率增益。第二条恒等式再把准确率随预算变化的曲线拆成「链内答案变化」与「还在跑的是哪些链」。在 MATH-500 上，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 在已持有正确答案的 379 个点（选取时不考虑链条如何结束）继续想，平均再丢 3.6 分（95% CI [2.2, 5.2]），损失集中在少数题。六个推理模型、MATH-500 与 OlympiadBench、预算至 16,384 token 时，准确率随预算下降主要来自「还在跑的是哪些链」，而仍在推理的链本身往往保住或改进答案。神谕式停止规则在 1.5B 与 7B 上最多只再得 +1.8 与 +2.5 分。框架要先说明该测什么，再去造停止规则。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21946 (Jianghong Zhou, Hao Rong, Chen Lin) notes that a reasoning model that has reached a correct answer can lose it by continuing to think. At a point on a chain, commitment is the probability that the answer the model would give if stopped now is correct, and verdict is the probability that the answer it will finish with is correct. The verdict alone, which is what final-correctness probes estimate, cannot decide whether to stop: as a forecast of a fixed outcome it has no predictable drift. The commitment-verdict gap equals the expected remaining change in answer quality and the accuracy gained by stopping. A second identity splits any accuracy-versus-budget curve into answer change within chains and change in which chains are still running. On MATH-500, at all 379 points where DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B holds a correct answer, selected without regard to how its chain ends, continuing loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), and the loss concentrates in a few problems. In six reasoning models from three families, on MATH-500 and OlympiadBench and with budgets up to 16,384 tokens, declining accuracy curves come from which chains remain, while the chains still reasoning keep or improve their answers. An oracle stopping rule gains at most +1.8 and +2.5 points at 1.5B and 7B. The framework says what to measure before building a stopping rule. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

judgment.en: Synthesis candidate: two sources of training-inference mismatch in LLM RL, plus bf16 rounding that silently discards most policy updates; no reliable single core term yet. Follow-up: humans& weight teleportation cuts RL trainer-to-sampler sync below 4 s (self-reported). Google Developers Blog (Nov 16; reached this window via TLDR AI on Nov 17): engineers make the RL sampler and trainer on TPU evaluate the policy bit-identically, eliminating the train–inference logprob mismatch that destabilizes on-policy LLM RL, which otherwise arises because decoding and training take different numeric paths. This is an engineering follow-on to this row’s train–inference mismatch / inference-engine numeric-error thread. Cross-reference t897 (DetLLM). Chaos only.

title.zh: LABEL：药品适应症与禁忌症在公开文本里的记录不对称——好处被写到的次数大约是安全限制的两倍，扩大模型只抬高适应症准确率

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.19166（S M Rayeed、Charles V. Stewart、Yao Ma）把药品「适应症 vs 禁忌症」在公开文本里的记录不对称命名为 LABEL。对 PrimeKG 中 574 种药物，在 Wikipedia 与 PubMed 摘要里，同一药物的好处被写到的次数大约是安全限制的两倍（文内比值 2.19）。语言模型跟着这个缺口走：Qwen2.5 从 0.5B 扩到 14B，适应症准确率升 18.3 分，禁忌症却一直接近随机；只要检索到写明答案的段落，两类事实用得一样好；把安全问题转到官方 FDA 标签，在标签写明该事实时还能再升 15.8 分。结论：模型在用药安全上失败，主要是因为自由文本语料缺少安全事实，而不是不会推理风险。代码与数据自称公开于 github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.19166 (S M Rayeed, Charles V. Stewart, Yao Ma) names LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits) for the documentation gap between a drug’s indications and contraindications in public prose. Across 574 drugs from PrimeKG, Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts are said to name a drug’s benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). Language models mirror the gap: as Qwen2.5 scales from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, while accuracy on contraindications stays near random guessing. title.zh: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked：在过程级真奖励可精确计算的试验台上，过宽的验证器会被「注水」——代理分到 0.940，真实忠实度却从 0.731 掉到 0.667

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.21538（Arunkumar V、Manoranjan Gandhudi、Gangadharan G. R.、Arun Prakash、S. Senthilkumar）：在 124,416 个上下文的可执行授权策略上，用精确过程级真奖励作试验台，再把验证器沿结果-only、充分性、召回、抽取噪声、粗糙分类、过期策略、LLM 裁判七条轴降质，同时用精确验证器给每个 rollout 打分。出现四种表型：乐观验证器会被「注水」——充分性代理分到 0.940，真实忠实度却从 0.731 掉到 0.667（96 个留出回合）；只看结果的验证器会饱和后不再教；噪声会稀释；保序的分差则无害。用验证器的选择误差和分差符号，加上短饱和试跑，可预判会落入哪一种。九种配置下表型会再现；充分性损伤在全部 10 个复制单元里为正，其中 7 个超出两倍标准差。损伤幅度本身未能复现。试验台与 14 条真实公开策略（Cedar、OPA、Gatekeeper）自称将公开。数字均论文自报，未复现。对照 t822、t908。不用已失败词 RLVR 作主词。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.21538 (Arunkumar V, Manoranjan Gandhudi, Gangadharan G. R., Arun Prakash, S. Senthilkumar) builds a testbed where true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle for every minimal sufficient reason. Verifiers are then degraded along seven axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge) while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: a sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching; noise dilutes; ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of selection error and gap sign, plus a short saturation pilot, is said to anticipate the phenotype. Across nine configurations the phenotypes recur; sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7. The damage magnitude does not replicate. The testbed and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) are to be released. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Cross-reference t822 and t908. Do not use the already-failed term RLVR. Chaos only.

title.zh: Role-filler binding：残差流里的线性探针几乎满分能读出角色，可言语化工作区的读数却低于随机对照——建在这些方向上的运行时监控会漏掉模型已经表示出的角色分配

summary.zh: arXiv 2611.19176（Dawlah、McMillin、Zhang、Ananth、Ruia、Zuñiga、Jiralerspong）：有人主张用可言语化工作区做运行时对齐监控，但这套工作区必须能分清角色绑定（「模型打算骗用户」vs「用户打算骗模型」）。在 Qwen3.6-27B、Gemma-3-12B、Gemma-3-27B-IT 上，用 J-lens / R-lens 与两种角色方向拟合方法，发现干净的分离：工作区里有能改变模型「怎么说角色」的方向，却没有模型用来计算绑定的表征。线性探针从残差流几乎满分读出角色，从工作区读数却低于秩匹配的随机对照；沿拟合出的角色方向做 steering，也不比同等强度的对照更能改绑定。消融工作区只在 Gemma-3-27B-IT 上损伤绑定，另外两款没有绑定特异的损伤。结论：建在这些方向上的工作区透镜监控会漏掉模型内部已经表示出的角色分配。数字均论文自报，未复现。仅 Chaos。

judgment.en: arXiv 2611.19176 (Dawlah, McMillin, Zhang, Ananth, Ruia, Zuñiga, Jiralerspong) tests a premise of runtime alignment monitors built on a verbalizable workspace: the workspace must carry role-filler bindings, such as “the model plans to deceive the user” versus “the user plans to deceive the model.” On Qwen3.6-27B, Gemma-3-12B and Gemma-3-27B-IT, with J-lens and R-lens and two methods for fitting the role direction, they find a clean dissociation. The workspace carries directions that steer what the model outputs about roles, but not the representations it uses to compute them. Linear probes recover role at near-ceiling from the residual stream but score below a rank-matched random control when reading the workspace, and steering along the fitted role direction changes binding no more than strength-matched control edits do. Ablating the workspace damages binding on Gemma-3-27B-IT only, with no binding-specific damage on the other two. A workspace-lens monitor built on these directions would therefore miss a role assignment the model itself represents. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

Linear probes recover role at near-ceiling from the residual stream but score below a rank-matched random control when reading the workspace, and steering along the fitted role direction changes binding no more than strength-matched control edits do. Ablating the workspace damages binding on Gemma-3-27B-IT only, with no binding-specific damage on the other two. A workspace-lens monitor built on these directions would therefore miss a role assignment the model itself represents. Figures are the paper’s own, not reproduced. Chaos only.

judgment.en: Simon Willison (Nov 17/18, linking a Prime Radiant post) describes the external-sandbox pattern: the agent lives outside the sandbox and sends every code execution to a dedicated sandbox server over a common localhost API, configurable from Pi, Claude Code or Codex. Three open implementations: v86 (Alpine in WebAssembly via Node), Apple Containers, and Microsoft Quicksand (QEMU+Alpine in a Python package). An optional HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy can be reconfigured at runtime, and a credential-replacement mechanism lets the agent make authenticated calls without ever seeing the secret.
